notes.title: Set a Watch: Digital Edition has arrived on iOS and Android! 📱
notes.content:
🔥 The wait is over, [b]Set a Watch: Digital Edition[/b] has arrived on [b]iOS[/b] and [b]Android[/b]! Grab the game now on your preferred mobile store:

[h3]🍎[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/set-a-watch-digital-edition/id6483861915?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=mobile_release]App Store[/url][/h3]

[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/set-a-watch-digital-edition/id6483861915?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=mobile_release][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548831/28f1eb70b5423f2af6779716dff064ac69a3e653.png[/img][/url]

[h3]🟢🤖[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.acram.SetAWatch&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=mobile_release]Google Play[/url][/h3]

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.acram.SetAWatch&utm_source=steam&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=mobile_release][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548831/2bf9de88e3d6429233f5046839e7bed29adb23f9.png[/img][/url]

[h2]What can you expect? [/h2]
🎲 [b]Roll your dice[/b] and decide how to use them to strike enemies or activate powerful abilities, with every result counting toward your survival.
⚔️ Explore [b]20 unique locations[/b], each filled with dangerous challenges, where countless monster combos create endless possibilities to master the chaos.
🧙 Choose from [b]six adventurers[/b], each with distinct skills and playstyles, and experiment with different team combinations on every run.
💫 Scout ahead, light a fire, equip powerful perks, or unleash ancient runes to [b]prepare for battle[/b] and gain the upper hand.


Experience the acclaimed board game wherever you go! 😀📱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548831/80c78a68b8cc2703888273163a0378533aba39ef.png[/img]

We’re officially opening the gates to the [b]Beta for Set a Watch: Digital Edition[/b]. 📩 Invitations have gone out to selected players, check your inbox carefully (and don’t forget your spam or junk folder). If you’ve been chosen, you’ll find all the details and instructions in your email on how to join the fight. ⚔️

notes.title: Add Set a Watch: Digital Edition to your Wishlist!
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to officially announce that [b]Set a Watch: Digital Edition[/b] is getting a [b]board game adaptation[/b] coming to [b]Steam[/b]! 🛡️🔥

If you love [b]tactical decision-making[/b], [b]dice-based combat[/b], and [b]the thrill of overcoming overwhelming odds[/b], this game is for you! We’re working hard to bring the beloved board game to life in an interactive format, and we can’t wait to share more with you.

[h2]🕯️ What is Set a Watch: Digital Edition?[/h2]
In this [b]strategic dice-management game[/b], you’ll assemble a party of unique heroes to hold back the darkness. At the start, you [b]roll your dice[/b], then proceed through the Camp phase before facing enemies in battle. Then, you can adjust your strategy and choose your next move - [b]attack directly[/b], [b]unleash powerful abilities[/b], [b]scout ahead[/b], or [b]prepare for the next wave[/b]. But beware… the Unhallowed won’t wait for you to be ready.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493430/Set_a_Watch_Digital_Edition/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=ann

🔥 Features:
 ✔️ [b]Tactical dice-based combat[/b] - Every roll matters!
 ✔️ [b]A party of unique adventurers[/b] - Choose from six heroes, each with distinct abilities.
 ✔️ [b]Replayable challenge[/b] - Randomized encounters, deadly Unhallowed, and ever-changing battles.
 ✔️ [b]Plan, fight, and survive[/b] – Victory is earned, not given.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493430/Set_a_Watch_Digital_Edition/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=ann][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548831/3658670beb8190793fe65ea3b1333e405114ed1f.png[/img][/url]

You can Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3493430/Set_a_Watch_Digital_Edition/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=ann][b]Set a Watch: Digital Edition[/b][/url] right now! By doing so, you'll be among the first to hear about updates, announcements, and launch details. Thanks for being part of our journey! 😀
